description: Create a text channel, voice channel, or category in a server. Requires the Manage Channels permission. For forum channels use discord_create_forum_channel instead. Returns the new channel's name and ID.

category_id.description: Optional category (snowflake) to nest the new channel under.

guild_id.description: Discord server (guild) ID (snowflake) to create the channel in.

name.description: Name of the new channel (max 100 characters).

topic.description: Optional channel topic/description. Applies to text channels only.

type.description: Channel type to create. Defaults to 'text'.

name: discord_create_channel
